name: eu_ai_act.pdf
description: Consolidated text of EU Regulation 2024/1689 (the Artificial Intelligence Act) of 13 June 2024, establishing harmonised rules on AI—including risk-based classifications, prohibited practices, high-risk system requirements, general-purpose AI model obligations, governance structures, penalties up to €35M/7% turnover, and amendments to sectoral EU legislation—accompanied by Annexes I–XIV covering harmonisation laws, high-risk use cases, technical documentation, conformity assessment, and systemic-risk criteria.
